method.observation: Only current first three groups of each main queue and the complete buffer; hidden tails are anonymous sentinels in planning.
method.strategy: Immediate clears, one extra visible-information ply, buffer space, visible matches, active queues, seeded tie breaks, and no repeated visible states.
method.caveat: Synthetic policy results, not human win rates. Lost means no legal operation at the reached state; no_progress and cap do not prove the original board unsolvable.
